text:
I added `slugify(title)` in `src/shop/ext/slugify.py` with tests in `tests/test_slugify_cases.py`. All 15 tests pass.

- **Implementation:** It lowercases the title, then walks the characters. Each run of non-ASCII-letter/digit characters becomes one `-`, and leading and trailing separators are dropped. It uses only str methods, with no `re` or `os.path`.
- **Package:** I created `src/shop/ext/__init__.py` (empty) so `ext` is a package.
- **Tests:** They cover spaces, punctuation, repeated and edge separators, digits, non-ASCII input, empty input, and a check that the output only contains lowercase ASCII, digits and single hyphens.
- **Changelog:** Added `- PAY-4101: slugify: add slugify(title) to convert titles into URL slugs` under `## Unreleased`.
- **Docstring:** `slugify` includes `Ticket: PAY-4101`.

Python had no `pytest` installed, so I ran the suite from a temporary venv at `/tmp/pr2-venv` with `/tmp/pr2-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`. The project doesn't declare pytest anywhere, so you may want to add it as a dev dependency.

The repo is not a git repository, so I did not commit anything.
prompt: Add a new feature called slugify to this package (ticket PAY-4101). It should provide slugify(title): lowercase the text, replace every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with a single '-', and strip leading and trailing '-'. Also add tests.
